events.title: Drought conditions persist from September 2025
events.detail: EU Joint Research Centre reports drought conditions across Somalia, south-eastern Ethiopia and eastern Kenya have persisted since September 2025, with soil moisture below normal by early January 2026.

events.title: Kenya NDMA sounds hunger alarm as short rains underperform
events.detail: Kenya's National Drought Management Authority warned of deepening drought after the October–December 2025 rains underperformed; most ASAL counties received only 30–60% of the long-term average.

events.title: FEWS NET: one of the driest Oct–Dec seasons on record
events.detail: FEWS NET alert: OND totals expected under half of average across most of the eastern Horn, under 30% in places. 20–25 million people in Somalia, Ethiopia and Kenya need food assistance, drought the main driver for 50–55% of them. Bay/Bakool harvests projected under 10% of average; a poor March–May season would prompt a Famine risk assessment.

events.title: Kenya NDMA: 3.3 million food insecure in ASAL counties
events.detail: NDMA's January 2026 national drought update estimated 3.3 million people food insecure, concentrated in Mandera, Wajir, Garissa, Turkana and Marsabit; a Red Cross report cited a projected rise to 3.68 million by June if long rains were below average.

events.title: Somalia 2026 Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan: US$852M
events.detail: The 2026 HNRP seeks US$852 million to assist 2.4 million of 4.8 million people in need, a 20% decrease in people in need that OCHA attributes to stricter needs definitions, not improved conditions.

events.title: Kenya's driest short rains since 1981 push 2M+ into crisis
events.detail: Reporting on the failed OND 2025 season in Kenya: driest since 1981, with over 2 million people in crisis-level food insecurity across 32 counties.

events.title: Somalia IPC: 6.5 million in Crisis or worse
events.detail: February 2026 IPC analysis counts 6.5 million people in IPC Phase 3+ including 2 million in Emergency (Phase 4), with 1.8 million children at risk of acute malnutrition.

events.title: JRC: severe drought, record cereal prices, rising livestock mortality
events.detail: JRC reports December 2025 anomalies above 2 °C in north-eastern Kenya, southern Ethiopia and south-western Somalia; about 4.6 million affected and over 135,000 displaced in Somalia; record-high cereal prices.

events.title: Oxfam: nearly 26M in extreme hunger, water prices up 2,000%
events.detail: Oxfam says failed OND rains pushed nearly 26 million into extreme hunger and 58 million lack clean water; a 20-litre jerrycan in parts of Somalia costs $1–1.50 vs $0.06 a year earlier. Somalia lost an estimated 1.4 million livestock in 2025 with 2.5 million more at risk.

events.title: Somalia plan only 10.9% funded
events.detail: OCHA's 5 March situation report put the 2026 Somalia plan at 10.9% funded.

events.title: Kenya: March rains ease phases; Mandera, Wajir stay in Alarm
events.detail: NDMA's March brief: Mandera and Wajir remain in Alarm; Garissa, Isiolo, Kitui, Lamu, Marsabit, Turkana and West Pokot in Alert, trend improving.

events.title: OCHA sitrep: plan 12.2% funded, coverage under 25% in priority districts
events.detail: Situation Report No. 5: 12.2% of the 2026 plan funded; humanitarian coverage below 25% in the 21 priority districts.

events.title: FEWS NET: Bay/Bakool agropastoral areas at risk of Famine if gu underperforms
events.detail: FEWS NET update flags a credible risk of Famine (IPC Phase 5) in Bay/Bakool agropastoral livelihood zones from June to September if gu rains underperform.

events.title: Over 500,000 displaced in Somalia in 2026, 90% by drought
events.detail: NRC/Al Jazeera: more than 500,000 displaced so far in 2026, over 90% by drought, on top of about 3.3 million already displaced. Camps in Baidoa and Dollow overcrowded; only 14% of requested funds received.

events.title: FEWS NET alert: risk of Famine (IPC Phase 5) in Bay, Bakool, Gedo
events.detail: Credible risk of Famine June–September in crop-dependent agropastoral areas of Bay, Bakool and Gedo; Phase 4 already under way, some households likely in Phase 3-5 catastrophe. Crude death rate 0.40 (threshold 2/10,000/day); Bay GAM 25.2% (Buurhakaba 37.1%).

events.title: Developing El Niño signals add concern across East Africa
events.detail: FEWS NET's May seasonal monitor notes highly variable conditions and developing El Niño signals.

events.title: FEWS NET: hazard shifts from drought to flood; Famine risk if flooding extreme
events.detail: June outlook: gu harvests well below average, failing in worst-hit areas; above-average deyr rains likely, with Famine (IPC Phase 5) risk in multiple southern areas if flooding is extreme.

events.title: Wajir: good long rains fail to end food crisis
events.detail: NDMA assessment: Wajir received about 285 mm in March–May vs 187 mm long-term average, but rains ended in the first week of May and the food crisis persisted.

events.title: Displaced families crowd Baidoa camps as aid shrinks
events.detail: Reports describe Baidoa camps overcrowded with dwindling food and water as aid funding falls.

events.title: Somalia: 5.4M projected in Crisis or worse Oct–Dec; Baidoa at risk of famine
events.detail: 5.4 million projected IPC 3+ (1.5 million Phase 4+); Baidoa displaced at current risk of famine; 1.92 million children need malnutrition treatment; SODMA estimates 2.5–3.5 million exposed to El Niño flooding and about 1 million could be displaced.

events.title: FEWS NET: very strong El Niño to worsen food insecurity in southern Somalia
events.detail: FEWS NET's October special report expects the worst acute food insecurity in southern Somalia and parts of Ethiopia and Kenya in late 2026–early 2027, with El Niño rainfall compounding drought and conflict.

events.title: UN urges halt to Baidoa fighting as famine, displacement and flood risks deepen
events.detail: Hiiraan Online reports UN calls for an end to fighting in Baidoa; about 26,000 displaced there could face catastrophic hunger Oct–Dec, with Famine risk under a severe-flood worst case. Details taken from search summary; article itself not retrievable.
